description: Add Event Bus module (agentwork/events/) - agent-to-agent pub/sub messaging with publish/subscribe, typed events, async handlers, event history/replay, and wildcard subscriptions.
steps: Create agentwork/events/event_types.py with pydantic-based event types: BaseEvent (with event_id, timestamp, event_type str), TaskStarted, TaskCompleted, TaskFailed, AgentHealthChanged, CustomEvent. Each event has an event_type class variable like 'task.started'.

Create agentwork/events/bus.py with EventBus class: subscribe(event_pattern: str, handler: Callable), publish(event: BaseEvent), unsubscribe(event_pattern, handler), clear(). Pattern matching supports exact match and wildcards (e.g., 'task.*' matches 'task.started', 'task.completed'). Use fnmatch-style matching. Handlers can be sync or async (detect with asyncio.iscoroutinefunction and run accordingly). publish() is sync and fire-and-forget (errors in handlers are logged, never propagate).

Add event history: EventBus stores published events (bounded, configurable max_history_size defaulting to 1000). Add methods: get_history(event_pattern: Optional[str] = None) -> List[BaseEvent], replay(event_pattern: Optional[str] = None, handler: Callable) that replays matching historical events to a handler.
Add async publish: publish_async(event: BaseEvent) that awaits async handlers. Sync handlers are called normally.

Create tests/test_events.py with comprehensive tests: basic publish/subscribe, wildcard matching ('task.*', '*'), unsubscribe, event history, replay, async handlers, handler errors don't crash bus, multiple subscribers same pattern, event_type filtering.
Export EventBus, BaseEvent, TaskStarted, TaskCompleted, TaskFailed, AgentHealthChanged, CustomEvent from agentwork/__init__.py and add to __all__
acceptance_criteria: EventBus supports subscribe/publish/unsubscribe with exact and wildcard patterns
Async and sync handlers both work correctly
Event history is bounded and supports replay with optional pattern filter
Handler errors are caught and logged, never propagate to publisher
All new tests pass: python3 -m pytest tests/test_events.py -q
